name: disk space
description: What is filling this desktop's disk: regenerable caches and build output with a delete button each, AI models (Hugging Face, Ollama), sizes of what can only be shown, and an on-demand large-file find. Deletes name a candidate the host computed itself, never a path. Experimental; off until switched on. macOS, Linux, and Windows through WSL.
summary: Shows what is filling this computer's disk and lets you delete the things that can be rebuilt.
places: Settings: free space from the last scan, and the full disk space screen
